extra_vocab.en: extra money paid to a worker, or an extra good thing
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見在人資與業績情境，指年終或績效「獎金」。也可指購物、旅遊中「額外附贈的好處」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bonus 的複數是 bonuses（不是 bonuss 或 bonus's）；表示獎金時是可數名詞。

example.en: Managers approved bonuses for all workers in the warehouse.
example.zh: 經理們核准了倉庫所有員工的獎金。

example.en: Staff expect a year-end bonus if sales reach the target.
example.zh: 如果銷售達標，員工期待有年終獎金。

example.en: The performance bonus is paid every quarter to the sales team.
example.zh: 績效獎金每一季發給業務團隊。

example.en: The company offered her a signing bonus to join the team.
example.zh: 公司提供她簽約獎金，邀請她加入團隊。

examples.en: Employees will get their bonus together with the December salary.
examples.zh: 員工的獎金會和十二月的薪水一起發放。

examples.en: She earned a large bonus after closing three big deals.
examples.zh: 她談成三筆大交易後，賺到了一大筆獎金。

examples.en: The bonus depends on the company's profit this year.
examples.zh: 獎金取決於公司今年的獲利。

examples.en: As a bonus, every customer gets a free bag with the order.
examples.zh: 作為額外贈品，每位顧客訂購都會得到一個免費提袋。

similar.diff: benefits 指保險、休假等「福利」；bonus 是額外給的「錢」。

example.en: The company offers health benefits and paid holidays to all staff.
example.zh: 公司提供所有員工健康福利與有薪假。

similar.diff: commission 是依銷售金額比例計算的「佣金」；bonus 通常是達標後的額外獎勵。

example.en: Sales agents earn a commission on every contract they sign.
example.zh: 業務員每簽一份合約就能賺取佣金。

example.en: Her salary is paid on the last day of each month.
example.zh: 她的薪水在每月最後一天發放。

example.en: He asked his manager for a raise after one year.
example.zh: 工作一年後，他向經理要求加薪。

example.en: A small incentive can help workers finish projects on time.
example.zh: 小小的獎勵可以幫助員工準時完成專案。

senses.en: extra money given to a worker for good work
senses.distinguish: 出現在薪水、業績、公司獲利的情境時，指獎金。

example.en: He used his bonus to pay for a business course.
example.zh: 他用獎金支付了一門商業課程的費用。

senses.distinguish: 出現在飯店、購物、促銷情境時，指額外的好處，常用 a nice bonus。

example.en: The hotel's free breakfast is a nice bonus for travelers.
example.zh: 飯店的免費早餐對旅客來說是個不錯的額外好處。

extra_vocab.en: a small space for selling, showing things, or doing one job
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見在展覽與商展情境，指公司展示產品的「攤位」。另外也常見 ticket booth（售票亭）和餐廳的卡座。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在攤位」用 at the booth；攤位編號寫成 booth + 號碼（booth 25），booth 前面不加冠詞。

example.en: Over fifty booths will be set up in the exhibition hall.
example.zh: 展覽館內將設置超過五十個攤位。

example.en: We rented a trade show booth for the three-day event.
example.zh: 我們為這場三天的活動租了一個商展攤位。

example.en: The ticket booth opens at nine o'clock every morning.
example.zh: 售票亭每天早上九點開放。

example.en: There is an old phone booth outside the train station.
example.zh: 火車站外面有一座老舊的電話亭。

example.en: Please write your booth number on the registration form.
example.zh: 請在報名表上寫下您的攤位號碼。

examples.en: Please stop by our booth to see the new product.
examples.zh: 請來我們的攤位看看新產品。

examples.en: Our booth is located next to the main entrance of the hall.
examples.zh: 我們的攤位在展館主要入口旁邊。

examples.en: Visitors can sign up for the free trial at the booth.
examples.zh: 參觀者可以在攤位報名免費試用。

examples.en: We asked for a booth near the window for the client lunch.
examples.zh: 我們為客戶午餐要求了靠窗的卡座。

confusable.diff: booth /buːθ/ 是「攤位」；both /boʊθ/ 是「兩者都」，拼法只差一個 o，發音也不同。

example.en: Both teams will share one booth at the trade show.
example.zh: 兩個團隊將在商展共用一個攤位。

similar.diff: stall 多指市場或街邊的小攤；booth 多指展覽會或有隔間的位置。

example.en: Local farmers sell fresh fruit at a stall near the station.
example.zh: 當地農民在車站附近的攤位賣新鮮水果。

example.en: The exhibition will be held at the city center next week.
example.zh: 展覽下週將在市中心舉行。

example.en: The new phones are on display at the front of the booth.
example.zh: 新手機陳列在攤位前方。

example.en: Visitors can take a brochure from the table for free.
example.zh: 參觀者可以從桌上免費拿一份宣傳手冊。

senses.en: a small area at a show where a company shows its products
senses.distinguish: 出現在展覽、商展、活動情境時，指攤位。

example.en: Our sales team will staff the booth for three days.
example.zh: 我們的業務團隊會在攤位駐守三天。

senses.en: a small closed space for one person or one job
senses.distinguish: 和 ticket、phone、guard 等字一起出現時，指小亭子。

example.en: The guard sat in a small booth at the parking entrance.
example.zh: 警衛坐在停車場入口的小亭子裡。

senses.en: a seat in a restaurant with a table and high backs
senses.distinguish: 出現在餐廳、點餐情境時，指有高椅背的卡座。

example.en: The waiter showed us to a quiet booth in the corner.
example.zh: 服務生帶我們到角落一個安靜的卡座。

extra_vocab.en: a flat case used to carry papers and a laptop to work
extra_vocab.note: 多益商務與出差情境常見，用來裝文件、筆電等。照片描述題也會出現「某人提著公事包」的畫面。

example.en: The store sells briefcases in black, brown, and gray.
example.zh: 這家店販售黑色、棕色和灰色的公事包。

example.en: She bought a leather briefcase for her first day at work.
example.zh: 她為上班第一天買了一個皮革公事包。

example.en: Most executives carry a briefcase and a laptop on trips.
example.zh: 大多數主管出差時會帶著公事包和筆電。

example.en: Keep the contract in a briefcase so it does not get lost.
example.zh: 把合約放在公事包裡，才不會弄丟。

examples.en: He always takes his briefcase to client meetings.
examples.zh: 他參加客戶會議時總是帶著公事包。

examples.en: A black briefcase was found in the meeting room yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天有人在會議室發現一個黑色公事包。

examples.en: Please keep your briefcase with you at the airport.
examples.zh: 在機場時，請隨身攜帶您的公事包。

confusable.diff: suitcase 是旅行用的行李箱，briefcase 是上班用來裝文件的公事包。

example.en: He packed clothes in a suitcase and documents in his briefcase.
example.zh: 他把衣服放在行李箱，把文件放在公事包。

example.en: Please check your luggage at the front desk before noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把行李寄放在櫃檯。

example.en: She took her laptop out of the case and started the meeting.
example.zh: 她把筆電從包裡拿出來，開始了會議。

example.en: Put the signed forms in the blue folder, please.
example.zh: 請把簽好名的表格放進藍色文件夾。

extra_vocab.en: a tool with a long handle used to sweep the floor
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在清潔、倉庫與辦公室的情境，照片描述題常見「某人正在用掃帚掃地」。常和 sweep（掃）、dustpan（畚箕）一起出現。

example.en: The hotel bought new brooms for the cleaning team.
example.zh: 飯店為清潔團隊買了新的掃帚。

example.en: He sweeps the shop floor with a broom every evening.
example.zh: 他每天傍晚用掃帚掃店裡的地板。

example.en: Keep a broom and dustpan near the kitchen door.
example.zh: 請在廚房門邊放一組掃帚與畚箕。

example.en: The cleaning supplies are kept in the broom closet on the second floor.
example.zh: 清潔用品放在二樓的清潔用具間。

examples.en: The janitor used a broom to clean the entrance hall.
examples.zh: 清潔工用掃帚打掃入口大廳。

examples.en: Please return the broom to the cleaning cart after use.
examples.zh: 使用後請把掃帚放回清潔推車。

examples.en: A worker grabbed a broom when the glass fell on the floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯掉到地上時，一名員工拿起了掃帚。

confusable.diff: broom 是「掃帚」；room 是「房間」，只差開頭的 b，發音也不同。

example.en: The cleaner left the broom in the storage room.
example.zh: 清潔人員把掃帚留在儲藏室裡。

similar.diff: mop 是「拖把」，用水拖地；broom 是「掃帚」，用來乾掃灰塵與垃圾。

example.en: Use a mop to clean the wet floor in the lobby.
example.zh: 請用拖把清理大廳濕掉的地板。

example.en: Hold the dustpan while I sweep the paper into it.
example.zh: 我把紙屑掃進去的時候，請你拿著畚箕。

example.en: The office vacuum is in the closet next to the kitchen.
example.zh: 辦公室的吸塵器放在廚房旁邊的櫃子裡。

example.en: The cleaner filled a bucket with warm water and soap.
example.zh: 清潔人員在水桶裡裝滿溫水和肥皂。
